_doc: Elementor setting patches from the 2026-11-13 design sweep, keyed by document then element id.
Applied to live pages by _tools/design_sweep_fixes.php and to generator output by
_tools/design_patches.py (build_pages.py / build_home_replica.py), so a rebuild keeps them.
'all' applies to every document that contains the element. Keys starting 're:' are regexes.
Settings are merged into the element's existing settings (shallow).

cta_h2._why: CTA band headline was clamp(40px,6vw,76px): 76px at 1440, bigger than the 54px page H1

re:^gal_\\d+_cell$._why: 2 x 48.5% + 16px gap left the gallery 11px short of the article edge

mis_row._why: About/mosaic row was full-bleed: copy sat 24px from the viewport edge instead of on the 1200 grid (wire: .home-mission__inner max-width 1200)

imp_head._why: 44% + 44% + 100px gap stopped 44px short of the grid; stacked on mobile it left a 100px hole between H2 and statement

st_grid._why: two story cards sat left in a 3-column row under a centred heading

re:^ab_hist\\d$._why: 4 x 23% + 60px gap stopped the timeline 36px short of the grid

prog_intro_row._why: image pair stopped 24px short of the grid

ct_map_eb._why: map band mixed a left heading with centred address and button

re:^nl_issue\\d$._why: white issue cards on a white section were invisible; read as large empty gaps

post_body_inner._why: content_width boxed made Elementor drop width:904 (the column was 1360px); only the content widget was centred by a CSS hack, so the Back button sat 148px left of the text
